description: minihub's plugin for Claude Code: a record of what agents change in configuration, and why
name: minihub

plugins.description: Keeps a record of what the agent changes in configuration, and why: each value changed, what it ran against a cluster, and what it said. Nothing is shown to the agent or added to its work. Read it with /minihub:changes. Needs no hub, server or account.
plugins.name: minihub
